status: four-panel temporal-phase mechanism test frozen after x-y-time-only preflight and before vertical outcome
role: post-freeze exploratory subset test; cannot alter v0.3.8 or rescue failed five-panel temporal family

ecological_hypotheses.temporal_allocation: Residual vertical individuality is largely generated by individuals placing similar movement modes in different portions of the tracked night/session.
ecological_hypotheses.within_temporal_context: Individual centered vertical organization remains non-exchangeable after matching coarse place, speed×turn state and early/mid/late session phase.

state_definition.temporal_phase: relative elapsed-time fraction among valid kinematic endpoints within each frozen session, split into thirds

estimator.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session median from all retained numeric-height events before selecting valid kinematic endpoints
estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, speed×turn state, phase3)
estimator.common_weighting: equal-session self distribution over jointly supported cell×state×phase strata, applied identically to self and other profiles

calibration.permutation_unit: whole centered session block with fixed x-y-time-derived kinematic states and relative phase labels
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight n; calibrated common cell×state×phase identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

decision_matrix.3_or_4_pass: Within the structurally evaluable subset, relative within-session timing of broad movement modes is insufficient as a general explanation.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Mixed temporal mechanism: timing differences may explain substantial individuality in some systems.
decision_matrix.0_pass: Consistent with temporal allocation explaining much of the residual signal in this subset, subject to support and power.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to Eidolon and no five-panel generalization.

claim_boundary: Relative session phase is not solar or circadian phase.
A PASS supports persistence within this temporal proxy, not intrinsic phenotype.
This subset is pre-outcome structurally defined but cannot rescue the failed five-panel temporal family.
stop_rule: Do not change phase3 definition, subset, 5-km grid, speed2_turn2, centering, bins, 50-event support, expected n, B/seeds or pass criteria after output.
If any exact n fails, invalidate rather than retune.
